observations.detail: Plan green evidence records 'Tests 22 passed (22)' (accurate at 7516f07c). Current targeted command shows 23 passed because commit e51561e4 added the 'falls back to a span when asked to render as script or style' test. The count increased (not decreased) and exit code remains 0. Not a blocker.

The implementation strips <style> blocks (STYLE_BLOCK_REGEX exists and is applied in sanitizeAuthoringText), but no dedicated test injects <style>evil</style> to verify the stripping. The script-block stripping IS tested. The <style> code path is exercised only if a sanitized field in the draft test happened to contain a <style> block (it doesn't). This is a minor test coverage gap — the regex is structurally identical to the script regex and the code path is adjacent.

Commit e51561e4 adds a valuable defense-in-depth layer to SanitizedText: type-level restriction (SafeTextTag excludes 'script'|'style') plus runtime fallback to 'span'. This prevents misuse through TypeScript type assertions, which the test exercises with 'as unknown as' casts.
